description: Curated SecHub Resources SC4S pack for GitHub audit/security JSON records relayed as one JSON object per line, with fixture-backed repository, organization/outside-collaborator, enterprise owner/admin, SSO credential authorization, token/app, Actions, audit-log streaming configuration, webhook, secret scanning, code/dependency security-alert, SSH certificate authority, and branch/rules families.

event_families.label: GitHub code scanning and dependency security alert events
GitHub branch protection and ruleset events

normalized_fields.action: GitHub audit action token such as repo.create
normalized_fields.user: Target user where present or actor fallback
normalized_fields.status: Resolution, operation type, or visibility where present
normalized_fields.src: Actor country code where present, not a network source IP
normalized_fields.alert_number: GitHub alert number where present for secret/code/dependency security alerts
normalized_fields.severity: Security alert severity where present; fixture-backed for code scanning only
normalized_fields.security_advisory_ghsa_id: Dependabot advisory GHSA identifier where present
normalized_fields.hook_id: Webhook identifier where present for hook administration events
normalized_fields.events: Webhook subscribed event list where present
normalized_fields.name: Webhook or enterprise/org policy name where present
normalized_fields.oauth_credential_type: Credential type for SSO credential authorization where present
normalized_fields.managed_token_scopes: Managed token scopes for SSO credential authorization where present
normalized_fields.user_agent: Audit request user-agent context where present; preserve for credential and webhook review
normalized_fields.request_id: GitHub audit request identifier where present
normalized_fields.invitee: Outside-collaborator invitee where present for org.add_outside_collaborator.
normalized_fields.public_repo: Outside-collaborator public repository flag where present.
normalized_fields.ssh_certificate_authority_id: GitHub SSH certificate authority identifier where present.
normalized_fields.fingerprint: SSH certificate authority fingerprint where present; synthetic fixture value only.
normalized_fields.audit_log_stream_id: GitHub audit-log streaming endpoint/configuration identifier where present.
normalized_fields.audit_log_stream_enabled: Audit-log streaming enabled/paused/disabled state where present.
normalized_fields.audit_log_stream_sink: Audit-log streaming sink type where present, such as s3 or another documented destination.
normalized_fields.new_s3_bucket: New S3 bucket destination metadata for audit-log streaming configuration changes where present; fixture value is synthetic.
normalized_fields.old_s3_bucket: Previous S3 bucket destination metadata for audit-log streaming configuration changes where present; fixture value is synthetic.
normalized_fields.secrets_updated: Whether audit-log streaming secrets were updated where present; no secret values are represented.
normalized_fields.business: GitHub Enterprise account/business slug where present.
normalized_fields.enterprise_role: Enterprise permission/role token where present for business.* audit events.

explicit_gaps: No live GitHub API export or audit-log streaming relay was exercised by adding this harness.

The harness uses synthetic-equivalent fixture JSON and does not prove collector pagination, checkpointing, streaming destination envelope metadata, Git event streaming, SARIF/advisory payload completeness, or enterprise export completeness.
Passing the harness would be lab replay/read-back evidence for this fixture route only, not field validation for a real GitHub organization or enterprise.

pack_variants.label: GitHub audit/security JSON relay
pack_variants.description: GitHub organization/enterprise audit JSON records preserving action, actor, org, business, repo, outside-collaborator, enterprise owner/admin, SSO credential authorization, token/app, audit-log streaming configuration, webhook, SSH certificate authority, secret scanning, code/dependency alert, Actions, and branch/rules context where present.
pack_variants.event_boundary: One GitHub audit/security JSON object per physical relayed line after API page, cloud/object-store, Event Hub, HEC, Cribl, or collector envelope unwrapping; native API pages, archive files, and batched arrays must be split before SC4S relay.
pack_variants.events_per_file_or_message: Fixture-backed relay shape is one source audit record per message/line. Bulk API exports, ZIP/TGZ/object-store files, and streaming destinations may contain multiple records before collector splitting and require local source-shape review.
pack_variants.uniqueness_or_multiline: Synthetic-equivalent fixtures use unique per-event markers and compact single-line JSON. Multiline JSON, embedded arrays, duplicate replay records, and collector retry semantics are not fixture-backed.
pack_variants.field_delimiting_or_escaping: Standard JSON object quoting/escaping with nested GitHub context preserved by default; no CSV conversion, field suppression, token/secret value inclusion, or lossy flattening is part of the default pack.
pack_variants.timestamp_timezone: Fixture-backed source timestamps use GitHub `created_at` / `@timestamp` millisecond epoch values interpreted as UTC. Collector-added timestamps, API-page retrieval time, and sink-local timezones require local validation before trust promotion.
known_limitations: No live GitHub audit relay replay/read-back captured.
Only one-line audit JSON payloads are fixture-backed; native streaming/cloud/collector envelopes need local capture.

Per-action optional fields vary; SSO credential, outside-collaborator, webhook, audit-log streaming, SSH certificate authority, and enterprise owner/admin fixtures cover metadata only, and code scanning/Dependabot alert fixtures do not state SARIF details, CVE/advisory payload completeness, or raw secret/token values.

cribl.notes: Use only after sampling the local GitHub audit feed. Do not drop action, actor, org, repo, timestamp, audit-log streaming metadata, token/app metadata, secret-scanning alert metadata, branch/ruleset context, or raw JSON by default.

vector.notes: Vector support is recorded as a conservative sources/transforms/sinks mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Vector config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

fluent_bit.notes: Fluent Bit support is recorded as a conservative collector/pipeline mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Fluent Bit config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

known_limitations: No live GitHub audit stream, SC4S runtime replay, or Splunk read-back evidence; keep curated/unverified and do not promote to validated/verified.
Fixtures are synthetic-equivalent examples, not real GitHub tenant audit records.

Only selected audit action/security-alert families are covered; complete GitHub audit taxonomy, Git event streaming, native HEC/cloud envelopes, retention behavior, SSO/outside-collaborator/webhook/audit-streaming/SSH-CA/enterprise owner optional fields, SARIF/advisory payload details, and collector wrappers remain future coverage.
Reduction candidates are opt-in and review-required; no default lossy drops are included.
